contract.provides: For odd prime p and W<=F_p^N, legal directions D(W,x)=(W intersect product_i{0,+x_i,-x_i}) minus {0}, x in (F_p^*)^N, generate support cone C(W,x). Hypothesis CB requires ONE fixed r in R_{>0}^N belonging to every C(W,x): sum_w lambda_{x,w} 1_{w_i!=0}=r_i with lambda>=0. Unequal coordinate clocks are allowed; state dependence is not. Under CB the note proves log|F_p^N/W|<=N(log3+(4/3)log2), hence p^{codim W}<=K0^N<8^N, K0=3*2^{4/3}. This is conditional existence, not an unconditional cover theorem or efficient algorithm.

source_excerpts.text:
ASTRA Primitive Genesis — Research result
This run produced a conditional entropy theorem, an exact counterexample to its most natural missing hypothesis, and an infinite family showing that the obstruction cannot be repaired by a constant-factor adjustment. It did not establish the requested foundational breakthrough.

The mechanism investigated is:

Construct globally constrained dynamics whose individual coordinates nevertheless follow exactly prescribed, low-entropy processes. Use their stationary distributions to bound the information capacity of the entire quotient space—without requiring independence.

The construction works under a precise compatibility condition. The unresolved issue is whether the full structure of an irredundant hyperplane cover supplies that condition. Merely having enough legal moves does not: I constructed an explicit counterexample.

The proofs, reproducible code, exact certificates and claim ledger are preserved in the 
research packet
. The 
research note
 is also available separately.

1. Independent opportunities investigated
I compared four directions before selecting the mechanism developed below.

Decisive objective	Representation or operation challenged	Outcome of this investigation
General arithmetic circuit lower bounds	Replace rank measures that work under depth restrictions with a measure that survives unrestricted cancellation and reuse of intermediate computations.	No suitable measure was constructed. The inspected shifted-partial-derivative results supply substantial low-depth bounds, not the general operation needed here. 
Resolution of singularities in positive characteristic	Construct a descending invariant that remains informative when blowups increase residual order.	No valid replacement invariant emerged. Explicit cycles of increasing residual order show why a straightforward transfer of characteristic-zero reasoning is inadequate; those cycles do not themselves disprove resolution. 
Rigorous critical three-dimensional Ising scaling	Replace an uncontrolled truncation of renormalised interactions with a transformation that preserves the correlations needed for a scaling theorem.	I did not construct a uniformly controlled transformation. This remained an exploratory opportunity rather than a result.
